name: Eurocircuits
verify_note: Capabilities change. Verify on the fab's capability page before ordering.

processes.label: PCB proto, 2 or 4 layer, 1.55 mm, 18 um outer / 35 um inner, 1-5 boards, 2-3 working days
notes: Service spec (services/pcb-proto): 'Layers 2 or 4', 'Quantities 1 to 5', 'Lead time 2 or 3 working days', 'Board thickness 1.55mm only', 'Copper 18um outer layers, 35um inner layers', 'Base material FR-4 Improved', surface finish 'Lead-free only. Eurocircuits chooses between ENIG and HAL, or you can specify', green mask and white legend both sides.

Minimum features (services/pcb-proto): '0.150mm track/spacing, 0.250mm finished PTH hole, 0.350mm finished NPTH hole'. Eurocircuits sizes are FINISHED (ENDSIZE); the production drill (TOOLSIZE) is finished + 0.10 mm for PTH and equal to finished for NPTH (classification page).

Derived cross-reference (not stated by the fab): on the May 2024 classification table 0.150 mm track/gap is pattern class 6 and a 0.25 mm finished PTH is drill class C; class 6 and class C are marked available in 'All Services'. Do not design to the limit - 'Always allow for a small margin above the classification limits'.

Annular ring: not stated for PCB proto -> null. Class-6 table values are OAR 0.125 / IAR 0.125 mm measured to TOOLSIZE; NPTH recommended ring 0.30 mm (drilled-holes page). Vias are PTH with finished size <= 0.45 mm by default.
Size: 'Minimum 20mm x 20mm. Maximum 580mm x 425mm (2L) or 500mm x 425mm (4L)'. max_board_size_mm records the 2-layer limit.

Hole to hole (tips-tricks smallest-distance page): plated holes on different nets need 0.25 mm base material between hole walls = 'need to be 0.35mm from each other, measured on the finished holes size'; same-net PTH 0.15 mm drill-to-drill (0.25 mm finished); NPTH 0.15 mm. Drilled-holes page: 'minimum drill hole to drill hole distance is 0.25mm (10mil) ... measured edge to edge of the drill TOOLSIZE'. min_hole_to_hole_mm uses the finished-size, different-net figure because KiCad measures finished hole edges.

Hole to copper: no outer-layer figure is published; inner-layer IPI (classification page) 'is always IAR + 0.075mm, with a minimum of 0.200mm'. Left null for this 2/4-layer process; the 4-layer DRU applies 0.2 mm on inner layers.

Board edge (copper-and-the-board-edge): '0.25 mm on outer layers with breakrouting', '0.40 mm on inner layers with breakrouting', '0.45 mm on all layers with V-cut scoring'; inner planes are always cut back 0.40 mm.

Legend (legend-print page, 27/02/2024): min line width 0.10 mm (4 mil) - thinner lines are removed; min text height 1.00 mm; 0.250 mm from a routed edge (0.450 mm scored), 0.100 mm from exposed copper, 0.100 mm from holes.

Soldermask (soldermask guideline): DI/LDI green/black/red/blue MAR 0.030 mm (mask edge to copper = expansion), MSM 0.075 mm (web between pads), MOC 0.060 mm; white/transparent PI mask MAR 0.100 / MSM 0.130 / MOC 0.090 mm; min mask opening 0.40 mm.
Castellation: 'Plated holes overlapping the edge are not available in the PCB proto service' (drilled-holes page). No blind/buried vias; resin via filling is an option.
Impedance: not mentioned for PCB proto -> null. Controlled impedance is a separate DEFINED IMPEDANCE pool (4/6/8 layers, 1.00 or 1.55 mm, Isola IS400).

processes.label: STANDARD pool, 2 layer (pooling), 5 working days
notes: Service spec (services/standard-pool): pooling layers 0/1/2/4/6/8 (10-16 non-pooling); 'Track/spacing pooling 0.100 mm, non-pooling 0.090 mm'; 'Min finished PTH 0.100 mm', 'Min finished NPTH 0.200 mm'; bare-board lead time 5 working days; electrical test standard from 2 layers.

Annular ring (services/standard-pool, pad diameter over finished hole): 'Outer PTH +0.300 mm' -> 0.150 mm ring per side on the finished hole (= 0.100 mm on the TOOLSIZE used by the classification table); 'Outer NPTH +0.200 mm' -> 0.100 mm.

Derived cross-reference (not stated by the fab): 0.100 mm track/gap is pattern class 8 on the classification table, 0.10 mm finished PTH is drill class E; drill class E limits max PCB thickness to 1.60 mm (aspect ratio 1:8). Cheapest pooled designs should stay well above these limits.

Copper (pooling): 2 layers '12, 18, 35, 70 um' (= approx. 1/3, 1/2, 1, 2 oz). Thickness (pooling, 0/1/2 layers): '1.00, 1.55, 2.40 mm'. Other thicknesses/weights are non-pooling via the online calculator.
Surface finish (pooling): lead-free HAL 'for best price', ENIG, LF HAL, immersion silver. Mask colours pooled: green, blue, black, white, red, 'PixtureBlackWhite'. Legend: white.
Size: 'Min PCB 5 x 5 mm, panel 50 x 50 mm'; '0L, 1L, 2L: 580 x 425 mm'. Slot/cut-out tool sizes '0.5, 1.2 and 2.0 mm' (min_slot_width_mm 0.5).
Board edge: '0.250 mm routed, 0.450 mm V-cut' outer layers.
Castellation: the STANDARD pool page lists 'plated holes on edge' and round-edge plating as options; Eurocircuits recommends edge-plated hole sizes of 0.80 mm and above (copper-and-the-board-edge).
Impedance: not offered within STANDARD pool; use the DEFINED IMPEDANCE pool (4/6/8 layers only) -> false for 2 layers.
Hole to hole, legend, soldermask and hole-to-copper notes: see pcb-proto process (same general guidelines).

processes.label: STANDARD pool, 4 layer (pooling), eC predefined build-ups, 5 working days
notes: Thickness: the STANDARD pool page lists pooling thickness '4 layers: 1.00 mm' and '6 to 16 layers: 1.55 mm'; other thicknesses (including 1.55 mm 4-layer, the PCB proto build) are available non-pooling via the calculator. Recorded as published; this differs from the 1.55 mm 4-layer PCB proto build.
Copper (pooling): inner layers '18, 35 um'; outer per the 2-layer list. Max size 'Multilayer: 500 x 425 mm'.
Inner-layer annular ring (services/standard-pool): 'Inner PTH +0.350 mm' -> 0.175 mm per side on the finished hole; 'Inner NPTH +0.250 mm'.

min_hole_to_copper_mm 0.200 is the inner-layer IPI minimum ('always IAR + 0.075mm, with a minimum of 0.200mm', classification page); no outer-layer figure is published. Inner-layer copper to routed edge 0.40 mm; planes are cut back 0.40 mm (copper-and-the-board-edge).

Stackups: 'Pooling: 8 predefined eC builds' - the page does not name or dimension them, and the Multilayer Standard Builds page says the >940 predefined build-ups are listed only in the online Buildup Editor. No stackup is recorded; pick the build-up in the PCB Configurator and export it from the Buildup Editor.

Impedance: DEFINED IMPEDANCE pool is the controlled-impedance service: '4, 6 and 8 Layers', pooled thickness '1.00mm (4 layers only)' and '1.55mm', base material Isola IS400, 'eC-predefined buildups: 2 for 4L'. STANDARD pool itself does not state impedance control -> false.
Everything else (track/gap, drills, hole-to-hole, legend, mask, edge, finishes) as standard-pool-2l.

PCB assembly capabilities page: 'Prototypes (from 1 pc) & Small series (up to 50 pcs)'; SMT, THT or mixed, single or double sided; 'Minimum chip component size: 0201'; BGA/LGA pitch '0.35 mm for a pin count of <=9', '0.40 mm for a pin count of >9'; QFP pitch 0.35 mm; 'Maximum 25.000 SMT component placements per order', 'Maximum 800 THT component placements per order'.

Board size for assembly: 'Minimum is 5 x 5 mm', 'Maximum is 340 x 440mm' (up to 400 x 510 mm after analysis). Solder alloy 'SAC 305 Sn 96,5 Ag3 Cu 0,5 lead free'. Lead times '3, 5, 7 or 10 Working Days' after bare boards are available; PCB proto assembly 6 working days total (3 fab + 3 assembly).
Sourcing: Eurocircuits sources all components; parts it cannot source may be supplied by the customer. 'Only assembly of boards produced by Eurocircuits'.

Data: BOM 'defines the parts by Description, MPN (manufacturers part number), SPN (suppliers part number)' cross-referenced to reference designators; a CPL (pick-and-place) file with position, rotation and side is required. Eurocircuits asks for as many generic parts as possible. Native-CAD BOM exports are imported through the PCBA Visualizer upload guides (bom-cpl-data page).
No per-'extended'-part fee model; quoting above 200 BOM lines or 1,000 placements goes to engineering.

file_requirements.gerber_format: Gerber X3 recommended ('top performing format'), Gerber X2 plus, or Gerber X (RS-274X) with a Gerber Job file; ODB++ and native KiCad/Eagle also accepted
notes: Accepted input (input-data-formats page): 'Eagle BRD (native CAD)', 'KiCAD (native CAD)', 'Gerber X3', 'Gerber X2 plus', 'Gerber X', 'ODB++'. Native .kicad_pcb upload is accepted: files 'should contain all the information necessary for production'. No KiCad version requirement is stated.

Packaging: one zip or rar archive containing only one version of the design, no folders, clearly named for the project. 'If you provide Gerber, you must also provide a Gerber Job file' (.gbrjob - KiCad writes this when 'Generate Gerber job file' is ticked).

Classification/pricing: the PCB Visualizer analyses the upload and assigns pattern class (3-10) and drill class (A-F); the smallest feature sets the class and the price; the classification table 'can only be put into praxis on PCB designs that have a Plating Index of 0.40 or higher'.
Vias are 'Plated Through Holes, default defined as <=0.45mm (18mil)'; this threshold ('Holes <= may be reduced') is adjustable in the PCB Configurator.
Legend should not be placed on exposed copper; outline in legend data as a 0.5 mm line centred on the true outline is acceptable (legend-print page).
